test_title: PYST 20: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 18 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: India achieved a historic feat by winning the presidency of which international organisation for the first time through the voting process?
solution:
The correct answer is __**International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** achieved a historic milestone by becoming the **President of the International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS) for the first time**. This achievement was secured through a voting process.
 
• The **International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS)** is a **global organization** dedicated to advancing the field of administrative sciences and governance.
 
• The **Indian delegation** played a key role in securing the presidency, which showcases India’s growing influence in the domain of international administrative and governance practices. *Hence, this statement is correct.*
 
• This achievement highlights **India’s commitment** to fostering international cooperation in administrative sciences and its role in shaping global governance policies.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the International Institute of Administrative Sciences (IIAS):**

 
 
• The **IIAS** is headquartered in **Brussels, Belgium**, and focuses on promoting the study and development of administrative sciences.
 
• The organization works to enhance **administrative efficiency**, governance, and public management at the international level.
 
• It serves as a platform for governments, academics, and practitioners to exchange ideas and best practices related to public administration.
 
 
 
• **India’s Role in International Organizations:**
 
 
• India has increasingly taken leadership roles in various **global organizations**, showcasing its growing influence and expertise in governance and administration.
 
• This presidency marks a significant achievement, highlighting India’s ability to contribute to global policy and administrative reforms.
 
 
 
• **Other International Organizations in the Options:**
 
 
• **United Nations Development Program (UNDP):** Works globally to eradicate poverty and reduce inequality. India is a key partner but has not held the presidency.
 
• **World Health Organization (WHO):** Focuses on global health issues. India has been a member and contributor but has not held the presidency.
 
• **International Labour Organization (ILO):** Promotes labor rights and social justice. India is a member but has not held the presidency.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **India’s Achievement:**

 
 
• India’s presidency of IIAS signifies its growing prominence in contributing to global administrative and governance systems.
 
• This achievement is a testament to India’s commitment to excellence in public administration and its ability to lead on the global stage.
 
 
 
• **IIAS Functionality:**
 
 
• The institute organizes conferences, seminars, and research projects to address contemporary challenges in governance and administration.
 
• It also publishes scientific studies and reports to guide policy-making and administrative practices worldwide.
